# Cover › Organic

**What belongs here.** The cover is a fluid, natural or noise-driven substance.

**Examples.** liquid fill, ink bleed, paint splat, smoke, reaction-diffusion

**Family test.** Pause at the middle: is the frame mostly or entirely a layer that is neither A nor B?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Ink Bleed](ink-bleed/) | Drops of ink land and spread with fibrous edges until the frame is solid, then the next scene bleeds back through. |
| [Liquid Fill](liquid-fill/) | Blobs of liquid grow into cells with thin veins, the veins pinch away until the frame is one colour, then the next scene floods back in the same way. |
| [Paint Drip](paint-drip/) | Paint pours down from the top in uneven drips that join into a solid frame, then drains away to show the next scene. |
